intro: Platform reviews usually answer one question: is it safe? With Diamant Kapitoire, the better first question is what the platform own pages concede, because they concede quite a lot.
It is a web platform with two modes: automatic, where the models execute according to your settings, and manual, where you confirm each entry yourself. Entry costs US$300 and includes a demo.

We graded Diamant Kapitoire on the same five dimensions as every review on this site: ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The number below is ours, and the evidence sits in the sections above it.
